_comment: Hand-written disambiguation table, not a statistical parser. A handful of words in the Word Library are deliberately listed under two categories because that's real English ambiguity (e.g. 'close' is genuinely both an adjective and a verb). The Slicer engine only opens this table when a word matches more than one Word Library list, and picks a category using nothing more than the category already assigned to the token immediately before it -- a single-word-of-context heuristic, not real syntax. slicer_cli.py reads this file directly; rules.js is a hand-synced mirror for the browser.
